scope: Real-model fixes 1-11 after the Phase 7 commit: hosted open-weight models on Groq as the default open profile, local embeddings, plan-only screening answers, Retry acknowledgement, trimmed model inputs, output caps, fixed risk flags with an injection floor, real fallbacks, hidden marketplace IDs, pricing facts and a repeatable smoke command; then a quality review of hosted outputs: interview times added by code, claim-checker hardening, evidence required in model drafts, cited screening answers, a pricing range with client history and a Connects check, risk flags in config, the JSON instruction as a prompt file, Compose model settings and smoke quality warnings

commands.typecheck_build: cd apps/web && npm run typecheck && npm run build
commands.browser: cd apps/web && PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chrome npx playwright test
commands.smoke_baseline: make smoke (before input trimming and ID removal)
commands.fallback_check: scratchpad driver: OpenModel.complete on the open profile with an unknown primary model name
commands.celery_check: scratchpad driver: real Celery worker and beat on Redis, SIGKILL during the writer, restart, POST /runs/{id}/retry, approve
commands.compose_config: POSTGRES_PASSWORD=dummy GROQ_API_KEY=dummy docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml config

full_regression.skip_reason: Real Postgres checkpoint service not configured

caught_issues: A provider-rejected request (404) was first counted as unknown usage, which would stop a healthy run; 4xx is now known zero usage and timeouts/5xx stay unknown
gpt-oss-120b failed Groq strict JSON-schema validation at an 800-token cap; JSON mode with the schema in the system prompt and larger caps validated 8 of 8 real calls
Before trimming, the writer prompt carried evidence hashes and marketplace IDs (1,931 tokens); after trimming it is about 1,180 tokens
The smoke check counted submissions only, so a reply without its slots and $50 bids passed until the drafts were read
Plan-only screening answers contradicted the PDF's evidence-citation requirement
Field names spend and paid_per_hire led the pricing model to call a $4,000 total 'per hire'; renamed to total_spend and average_paid_per_hire
The new evidence rule first overwrote human edits without citations; it now applies to model drafts only
warnings: LangGraph's async SQLite store can log 'Task was destroyed but it is pending' when a run's store closes; benign and seen before these changes
Node 26 prints a DEP0205 module.register deprecation warning during Playwright runs
external_limits: Official GigSim, persona corpora, policy pack, 2 November update and dev set remain unavailable; all outcomes are mock
Groq free-tier rate limits apply; the local qwen3:1.7b fallback was not pulled or run
Real Postgres, the full Docker Compose stack, public deployment, tracing links and human labels remain pending
secrets: The Groq key is only in the git-ignored .env; it is not in any tracked file, results file or log
commits_pushes_branches_prs_or_publicati: Nothing committed at check time; the user reviews and approves the commit. No push, branch, PR or publication.

findings_in_hosted_runs: One sent reply asked the client to pick from interview slots it did not list; the claim checker removed the slot list
Two of three bids were the $50 minimum on a $900 job
Plan sentences with curly apostrophes were removed as unsupported claims
One proposal kept no evidence sentence; another kept an orphaned sentence after its subject was removed
pdf_differences_fixed: Screening answers were plan-only; the PDF asks for evidence citations
Pricing lacked client spend and a Connects decision
Risk flags were hard-coded instead of configured
Compose could not run the models (no key or Ollama service)

first_with_new_rules.note: second proposal hit 12,150 of 12,000 tokens after two rewrites of embellished evidence sentences

after_wording_and_feedback_fix.note: price reasons read the client's $4,000 total as per hire

quality_review.compose_config: valid with dummy values; MODEL_PROFILE, GROQ_API_KEY and OLLAMA_URL reach api, worker, beat and migrate
deferred: Model selection by measurement at the end
Stripping injected sentences from model input
Market statistics until GigSim historical jobs exist
